crossRefs.note: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came…
If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if Yahweh is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his…
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in, and reported that Peter was standing…

translations.web: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
translations.bsb: If I summoned Him and He answered me, I do not believe He would listen to my voice.
translations.kjv: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
translations.asv: If I had called, and he had answered me, Yet would I not believe that he hearkened unto my voice.
